Class StationDetailDTO

java.lang.Object
dto.StationDetailDTO
public class StationDetailDTO extends Object
A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for representing detailed station information. This class encapsulates a station's complete information including its buildings and is used to transfer this comprehensive data between different layers of the application.
